test_TapasModelTest: test the TapasModelTest class that validates TapasModel, TapasForMaskedLM, TapasForQuestionAnswering, and TapasForSequenceClassification
test_TapasUtilitiesTest: test the TapasUtilitiesTest class that validates IndexMap, ProductIndexMap, flatten, gather, range_index_map, reduce_sum, reduce_mean, and reduce_max
run_TapasModelTester: run the TapasModelTester class to generate config and inputs for testing Tapas model variants
test_TapasModelIntegrationTest: test the TapasModelIntegrationTest class with pretrained models for inference on conversational, weak supervision, and strong supervision question answering
prepare_tapas_inputs: prepare single or batch table-question inputs for TAPAS inference or training using prepare_tapas_single_inputs_for_inference, prepare_tapas_batch_inputs_for_inference, or prepare_tapas_batch_inputs_for_training
